messages:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for service 'realtime-inference-prod' (svc_9a2b). Trigger: high 5xx rate (>10%) across prod-inference cluster. Incident URL: https://pagerduty.example/INC-98123

alex: Anyone else getting paged for the wrong service? Payload shows 'ops-platform' as the routing tag, but alert is clearly about model-serving latency.

incident-bot: Assigned to mira (oncall). Escalation policy: default-night.

mira: acking and jumping in. looking at PD event now. can someone paste the PD payload?

pagerbot: PD event dump:
```
alert_id: e5f1a7
service: realtime-inference-prod
routing_tag: ops-platform
escalation: contractors-rotation
trigger: 5xx_rate > 10% (window=2m)
```

sanjay: i'm receiving the same page but i'm not on rota for inference. contractor rotation got included somehow. i was paged on phone at 02:12.

kate: fwiw i just merged a routing-rule PR 2 hours ago that touched alert->service mapping (PR #842). it added a fallback route for alerts without team_tag to go to ops-platform. might be the culprit.

alex: yep i see that PR. snippet: 
```
if not alert.labels.team:
  route -> ops-platform
```
that fallback probably matched alerts missing the new 'team' label.

mira: ok working theory: producers didn't set team label for this rule, alert matched fallback -> ops-platform -> contractors rotation. mitigation plan: reroute current incidents to model-serving-ops team and remove contractors from escalation for this alert.

olivia: customer impact? Do we have an estimate of affected customers / latency hit? any external-facing errors?

mira: quick numbers from dashboards: 5xx spikes on inference pool 3,4,5. ~12% of requests failing for the last 6 minutes. traffic routed to hosted-api path for a subset of customers (mostly small-batch PLG) — looks like ~120 p99 requests affected. no broad outage but increased e2e latency and some failed requests.

sanjay: suggest temporary PD patch to change escalation target for svc_9a2b to model-serving-prod and remove contractors-rotation. i'll do the PD edit unless mira wants it.

mira: please do it, @sanjay. i'll also add a temporary rule to the alerts-router to prefer team=model-serving when label missing. commands i ran: 
```
pdctl service update svc_9a2b --escalation model-serving-rotation
pdctl escalation remove contractors-rotation --service svc_9a2b
```

pagerbot: PagerDuty: escalation updated by sanjay. New on-call: mira (model-serving-rotation). Contractors removed from escalation chain.

kate: rolling back the fallback from PR #842 now (hotfix), will revert to previous mapping and make explicit team labels required.

olivia: thanks. can we draft a short customer note? something like: 
"We detected increased errors impacting a small subset of inference requests between 02:05–02:20 UTC. Engineers mitigated the issue; retries should have succeeded. If you see persistent errors, please contact support."

alex: +1. send to customers who hit 5xx threshold. add link to status page once I update post-incident metrics.

mira: mitigations applied: scaled inference pool + warm standby model; rollback of PR applied; PD routing patched. error rate down to 1.8% over last 3m. continuing to monitor.

sanjay: creating a follow-up incident ticket to track root cause and remediation tasks. assigning to kate, alex.

kate: action items: 1) revert PR fully and add unit test for missing team label, 2) update alert producers to emit team label, 3) add PD routing tests in CI, 4) follow-up postmortem.

olivia: please include customer impact numbers in the postmortem (requests affected, duration, any SLO breaches). i'll prepare the external blurb once we have final numbers.

mira: will run through timeline and attach logs. closing live page once stable for 15m.

incident-bot: Incident marked stable by mira. handoff note: follow-up owners kate/alex/sanjay.

alex: thx all. good quick coordination. :thumbsup:
